slides.title: Safety tips for using wheelchair
slides.english_text:
Safety tips for using wheelchair
➢ Always LOCK the brakes when you leave the patient or when not being pushed.
➢ Avoid leaning forwards or bending to reach low objects
➢ Never stand on the footplates
➢ Use safety straps if provided (especially when going outdoors or for patient with poor sitting balance)
➢ Make sure:
➢ Feet safely on the footplates
➢ Elbows, all clothing, rugs or bags are tucked in safely.
➢ Always let the client know what you are going to do

slides.title: Using the wheelchair - Getting into the wheelchair
slides.english_text:
Using the wheelchair - Getting into the wheelchair
• LOCK the brakes!
• Fold up the footplates and swing sway.
• Stand with back of leg against the seat and press down on armrest.
• Lower and place foot on footplates.
• Pay attention to keep the heel clear of the front casters. Getting out of the wheelchair
• LOCK the brakes!
• Fold up the footplates and swing sway.
• Make sure walking aids(if needed) is ready.
• Slightly bend trunk forwards, standing up by pressing down on the armrest

slides.title: Using the wheelchair - Getting down a kerb
slides.english_text:
Using the wheelchair - Getting down a kerb
➢ Going down backward
➢ Pull the rear wheels gently down onto the road
➢ Step and push one tipping lever with foot to balance the rear wheel when pulling and lowering the front caster down onto the road

slides.title: Using the wheelchair - Getting up a kerb
slides.english_text:
Using the wheelchair - Getting up a kerb
➢ Push the wheelchair until the footplates are at the edge of the kerb
➢ Hold the wheelchair handles firmly and tilt the chair backwards (pressing down the handle and step and push on the tipper lever)until the back wheels touch the kerb.
➢ Place the front caster on the path
➢ Use the handles to lift and push the wheelchair forward.

➢ Facing towards the slope
➢ Keep back straight and use lower limbs muscles
